title: Customer 360 profile projection exposes every required field group with verified handles only
risk: An agent answers from an incomplete or unverified profile, so a statement about the customer is wrong and a handle the customer never proved is treated as identity.
preconditions: Tenant T1 seeded with cust-a, cust-b, cust-guest, cust-dormant and orders ORD-A-1/ORD-B-1 in run namespace run-t1-c360-001-*
Projection read through the tenant-scoped repository wrapper at frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z; no live connector is called

steps.action: Read the Customer 360 projection for (T1, cust-a) and enumerate the returned field groups
steps.expected: all 15 required field groups are present with a value or an explicit null; none is silently omitted

steps.action: Compare the aggregate fields against the ERP order mirror (ORD-A-1, SKU-OK, 1000 TWD)
steps.expected: products_purchased contains SKU-OK, last_purchase_at matches ORD-A-1 and total_spent is 1000 TWD from the mirror, not from a model

steps.action: Read the projection for cust-guest and for cust-dormant
steps.expected: cust-guest yields no FACT profile and zero verified handles; cust-dormant exposes inactive_days 120 and lifecycle dormant

steps.action: Retry the same read under tenant T2 and separately send a client payload asserting verification_status VERIFIED for cust-b
steps.expected: the T2 read returns 0 rows for cust-a and the client assertion changes neither verification nor released handles

assertions: The projection returns all 15 required field groups for cust-a and the values match the ERP mirror (ORD-A-1, SKU-OK, 1000 TWD)
Only handles backed by a server-verified identity row are released; cust-guest returns zero verified handles and no FACT profile
Derived attributes appear with the _hypothesis suffix and are absent from the customers System-of-Record mirror
A cross-tenant read of cust-a under T2 returns 0 rows instead of any customer data
forbidden: Release a handle that has no verified identity row, for example an address echoed back from the request payload
Return cust-b profile content inside a cust-a projection read
evidence: Redacted projection result for cust-a and cust-guest with the 15-field presence check
ERP mirror comparison for ORD-A-1 showing the projected aggregates
